hook_patterns_by_type.name: Reel Hook Pattern Library
hook_patterns_by_type.when: When writing hooks for short-form vertical video

contrarian_hook.description: Challenge a common belief to stop the scroll
contrarian_hook.example: 'Everyone says you need 10k followers to make money. That's a lie.'

curiosity_gap.description: Present specific experiment with results implied but not revealed
curiosity_gap.example: 'I posted every day for 30 days. Here's exactly what happened.'

direct_address.effectiveness: Very High — viewer feels personally called out
direct_address.description: Call out viewer by naming a behavior or belief they have
direct_address.example: 'If you're posting every day and getting no engagement, here's what you're doing wrong.'

pain_point_amplifier.description: Name a specific frustration and promise a solution
pain_point_amplifier.example: 'Tired of creating content that nobody sees? Here's the fix.'

result_brag.description: Lead with a specific impressive result
result_brag.example: 'I generated 200 leads in 7 days with one post. Here's the exact strategy.'

story_opener.effectiveness: High — narrative hooks keep viewers watching
story_opener.description: Open in the middle of a story to create narrative tension
story_opener.example: 'Two years ago I was broke. Last month I hit $50K in revenue.'

question_hook.description: Ask a question that makes the viewer stop and think
question_hook.example: 'What if everything you know about Instagram is wrong?'

stat_or_fact.description: Open with a surprising statistic or little-known fact
stat_or_fact.example: '90% of businesses never follow up with leads. That's $1T in left money.'

key_tactics: The first 0-3 seconds are all you get — no warm-up, no logo, no intro
Contrarian hooks work best for authority and thought leadership content
Curiosity gaps work best for educational content and case studies
Direct address works for pain-point content where audience is problem-aware
Specific numbers build credibility faster than vague claims
The hook must match the audience's awareness level — unaware audiences need different hooks than problem-aware ones
Highest effectiveness hooks: Direct Address, Contrarian, Curiosity Gap, Result Brag
